name: agent-commons
title_zh: 跨会话找回 Agent 收件箱的共享记忆接线员
tagline_zh: 每次新会话，Agent 都忘了上回聊到哪。装上它，配置好的项目 Agent 能跨会话找回收件箱。
tagline_en: Tired of your agent forgetting context each session? Wire it to Agent Commons, restore its inbox, and keep.
desc_en: Connect a configured project agent to Agent Commons, recover its inbox across sessions, and use scoped messaging and shared learnings.
why_zh: 把记忆从会话里抽出来，放到项目级公共空间。不是聊天记录堆叠，是结构化的收件箱与经验沉淀。
why_en: It lifts memory out of the chat log into a project-level commons—structured inbox and shared learnings, not raw transcripts—so.
limit_zh: 只服务已配置好 Agent Commons 的项目 Agent；需要你手动指定项目身份与接入点。
limit_en: Only for project agents already configured for Agent Commons; requires manual project identity and endpoint setup. It handles memory and routing.
title_en: Reconnect your agent's inbox and shared memory across.
